documents.title: About Castor Telecom
documents.text: Castor Telecom is a telecommunications operator selling mobile and fixed broadband to 11 million subscribers. The company runs networks in three countries from a head office in Warsaw.

documents.title: Castor Telecom confirms network restructuring
documents.text: Castor Telecom confirmed layoffs of 900 roles on 2026-08-05 as part of a restructuring of its network division. The company said the cuts follow a review of capital spending.

documents.title: Careers at Castor Telecom
documents.text: Castor Telecom is hiring for 12 open roles in its data and analytics team, listed on 2026-07-01. The team sits inside the group technology function.
